name: pmjob-mock-interview
description: Runs a practice interview round where Claude plays a stand-in interviewer for the format you choose and asks follow-ups, then writes Mock Interview Notes on each answer against a rubric you see first, as present, thin or missing, with one sharper version of your weakest answer in your own facts. Use for "run pmjob-mock-interview", "mock product interview", "practise my interview out loud", "play the interviewer", "rehearse the behavioural round", "practice interview with follow-up questions", "notes on my interview answers", "rehearse before the final round", part of the Claude Guide for Product Interviews Pack by 90n.
